title: CSV Matches What You Saw
description: The downloadable CSV is supposed to be the same report you were just looking at on screen — same range, same grouping, same numbers — not a report generated from whatever the query happened to be by the time the job actually ran.
successCondition: With a specific date range, group-by, and timezone set and the on-screen data table rendered, clicking "Generate CSV report" and waiting for it to become ready, then downloading it via the "Download CSV" link (GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id/download), results in CSV content whose header row reads exactly "period,shipmentCount,revenueCents" and whose data rows exactly match the on-screen table's periods, shipment counts, and revenue-in-cents values, row for row.
hints: The download link's href is api.reportJobDownloadUrl(job.id) — fetch it directly with the current auth to inspect the raw CSV text rather than relying on a browser save dialog.
Don't change any filter between generating the on-screen table and requesting the CSV job — this challenge is checking they agree for the same query, not across two different ones.
